name: Sensei Lanai, A Four Seasons Resort
positioning: Adults-only wellness resort in the uplands of Lanai, with private spa hale and dining by Nobu
best_for: Travelers who want a personalized wellness stay on a secluded island
Adults who prefer an adults-only setting

facts.text: The address is One Keomoku Highway, Lanai City, Hawaii.
The resort describes itself as an adults-only wellness enclave on the secluded Hawaiian island of Lanai.
The resort is located in the lush, rolling uplands of Lanai.
Sensei by Nobu is the resort's restaurant, serving meals morning, noon and evening.
Koele Garden Bar is located just off the lobby.
The spa has 10 private spa hale.
Two of the spa hale feature Watsu pools.
The heated outdoor pool has two 25 metre lap lanes.

highlights.text: Spa treatments take place in a private spa hale.
Daily fitness and wellness classes are complimentary.
The menus were designed by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa and his team.
The Sensei Library has a collection of over 700 curated titles.
Round-trip luxury flights between Honolulu and Lanai are offered when you stay in any room or any suite.

considerations.text: Only 30 miles of Lanai's roads are paved.
Lanai Air flights between Honolulu and Lanai operate between 7:00 am and 6:00 pm.
The Jack Nicklaus Signature Manele Golf Course is located at Four Seasons Resort Lanai, not at this resort.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
